newsitem.title: USA: Neenah Corp sells $150 million in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: Neenah Corp sells $150 million in junk bonds.

text.p: The following 144a private placement from Neenah Corp was priced on Wednesday via Chase Securities Inc, market sources said.
The size of the deal was increased from an original size of $140 million.
Neenah, based in Neenah Wisc, is one of the largest manufacturers of iron castings, such as manhole covers and sewer grates, for municipal and industrial customers.
Proceeeds from the offering will be used in connection with a leveraged buyout of the company being led by Citicorp Venture Capital, market sources said.
